notes.title: Game update & french version
notes.content:
Update

- "Dr.Commodore Logs" are now available in the right order even if you discover computers in a strange order.
- French version! (Hello, mothertongue!)

notes.title: Shadows and secrets of Allan Commodore
notes.content:
Hello,

Allan was updated:
- A backstory was added through eight additional secrets.
- Asynchronous text was added in a lot of cases to avoid breaking the game rythm
- Particles and graphical effects were added (Concentration aura, blood...)
- When the character is very injuried, you will feel dizzy (a little)
- 3D with teal and red glasses : press F1 to trigger it
- Additional voices and texts
- An improved tutorial
- A level loading error was fixed - the kind that use to exit the game
- A game over screen was added
- The final fight area was soften
- The EFRITS splash screen was added: the computer science and information technology school to which all gains are gonna be given.
